name: Nagybakónak (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nagybakónak: a blue and red shield with a bunch of grapes, a pruning knife and a crown, above a yellow scroll inscribed NAGYBAKÓNAK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
